verdict.rationale: Datadog has a dedicated first-party Service Level Objectives documentation page and a Monitors page, so defining SLOs and alerting on them is supported. The pack gives only page titles, though, with no content describing error-budget tracking or burn-rate alert configuration. missing for 10: explicit evidence of error-budget calculation and burn-rate alerting, doc content beyond titles, independent or hands-on corroboration of SLO workflows.
